title: Cannot download/stream file greater than 128mb using hono
body:
My team and I have been using hono in many services and loving it a lot.
However recently we made a worker to download our files from an r2 bucket, but whenever we tried, it gave errors.

Whenever I try to download a large file:
```
GET https://mybucket.mydomain.com/get/test200m - Ok @ 08/08/2022, 20:06:00
  (log)   <-- GET /get/test200m
  (error) TypeError: Memory limit would be exceeded before EOF.
    at parseBody (index.js:334:35)
    at index.js:970:49
    at async index.js:884:9
    at async index.js:793:9
    at async index.js:902:9
    at async Hono2.dispatch (index.js:733:21)
  (log)   --> GET /get/test200m 500 155ms
``` 

The URL `/get/test200m` gives me `Internal Server Error`.

I tried working around it and found that normal module workers were able to easily perform this operation.

Hono code to download file, which *does not work*:
https://github.com/divideprojects/cdn/blob/6f1c5178ea33b2f19e7cdd72bbdc9873e538aafc/src/_fileOperations.ts#L6...L32
hono routes:
https://github.com/divideprojects/cdn/blob/6f1c5178ea33b2f19e7cdd72bbdc9873e538aafc/src/index.ts#L21


Without hono, which *works*:
https://github.com/divideprojects/cdn/blob/21550bb848fc016c3a83338236fe4700681e8df9/src/index.ts#L36..L75

I was able to download the file without hono but with hono I'm running into issues.
